title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: The same question, asked of the other four
summary: Shift every cut by one character and see which counters notice. The witness guarding the deletion of test files noticed nothing.

highlights.title: The test removal witness catches an offset shift
highlights.description: It guards the only edit that deletes whole test files, and it was missing the rule that a cut of a test function takes whole lines. The same one character shift now reports thirteen violations out of thirteen cuts.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: The witness for removing a declaration together with its tests checks that a cut of a test function takes whole lines.

sections.heading: Notes
bullets: The other three hold: 98 of 98 symbol cuts, 320 of 320 member cuts, 100 of 100 orphaned imports.
The enum family allows a partial cut by design. Of its 33 cuts, a shift leaves whitespace in 20 and a legal trailing comma in 6; the 7 that eat a letter of the name are all caught.
